description: SLS 8.7's continuation chain on one H4 series -- external sweep, displaced BOS, retrace into an OB_A/OTE stack -- classifies as A3 at exactly its floor of 70 and publishes a signal.
labelling_rationale:
SLS 8.7's chain, end to end, on one H4 series: H4 BULLISH with the rung above declared BULLISH, an external SSL sweep, a displaced BOS up, a retrace into a stack of two BULLISH zones in discount, and archetype A3 published. It is the first golden in which any candidate publishes. That is what makes it more than a scoring case: until this dataset the engine's publish path had never run in the suite, so a soak that published nothing could not be told apart from a publish path that writes nothing.

Declared context. htf_state BULLISH stands for 8.7's 'D1 BULLISH', the timeframe one rung above H4. It is declared, not asserted; everything else below is derived from the candles.

Structure (3.3, 3.4, 3.5). The first three zigzag legs print external HH 118.5 and 124.5 and HL 111.5 and 117.5 after the seeds, so 3.4's two-pair rule puts H4 in BULLISH and G2 is satisfied trend-following. Scenario candle 38 wicks to 115.5, below the HL at 117.5, so 3.3 labels that low LL; it closes back at 118.6, so no break down is recorded. Candle 39 closes at 126.2 through the external high at 124.5: BOS_UP.

Liquidity (4.6, 4.7). Candle 38 is a single-candle sweep of the external SSL pool at 117.5: 2.0 through the level and a close back inside, depth 2.0 / ATR 1.958 = 1.02 ATR. Candle 39 is a 5.10 displacement in the reversal direction, closing one candle after the sweep and back through more than half of the penetration candle's range, so 4.7 records a stop hunt.

Legs (7.5). 38 to 41 is an IMPULSE UP: it contains the displacement and makes 5.97 ATR of progress. 41 to 45 is a RETRACEMENT DOWN of 71% with no displacement in it. The pullback low at 119.5 is an external swing once its fifth follow-up candle closes (k = 5), which is why the scored close is candle 51 and not earlier.

Zones and PD (5.1, 5.7). The origin run ending at the sweep candle becomes OB_A [115.5, 120.45]; the impulse also leaves a BULLISH OTE band. The close at 121.1 is within 0.5 x ATR (0.898) of both, so G4 passes with a stack of two. The dealing range is the external low 119.5 to the external high 129.5, range_position 0.16, which opens 5.7's long gate for G3; the DOWN direction fails G2 and G3 on the same candle, which is the contrast that shows the gates discriminate by direction.

Factors (8.3.1). F1 = 15 confirmed break + 18 displaced (the BOS sits inside the displaced impulse leg) + 12 external + 7.5 trend maturity (one unbroken HH/HL pair since the LL: 1/4 x 30) + 15 clean record (no failed break, and the BOS is twelve candles old, past 3.5's three-candle window) = 67.5. F2 = 20 confirmed + 16 external + 12 depth (1.02 ATR saturates at 1) + 6 unclaimed + 6 fresh (inside 4.6's 15-candle expiry) + 15 stop hunt + 25 x 23.5417/100 = 5.8854 for the nearest external BSL at 129.5, whose strength is 4.3's as the liquidity engine records it = 80.8854. F3 = OB_A 40 + state 6 + stack 15 = 61. F4 = 50: no spike, expansion or contraction at the scored candle. F5 = 12 steady + 20 no exhaustion = 32. F6 = 100: the HTF matches D.

8.4: 67.5 x .20 + 80.8854 x .15 + 61 x .20 + 50 x .15 + 32 x .15 + 100 x .15 = 13.5 + 12.1328 + 12.2 + 7.5 + 4.8 + 15 = 65.1328. 8.5: the zone-stack synergy of +5 gives 70.1328, floored to 70.

8.6: A1 lacks an MSS and A2 a breaker; A3's chain holds -- trend, displaced BOS, retrace into zone, HTF aligned, a retracement leg with no counter-displacement -- and 70 meets A3's floor of 70 exactly, which pins the floor as inclusive. 9.4 grades 70 as B.

Publication (15.2, 15.3, 12.5, 10.3). Entry is the OB band, proximal 120.45 and distal 115.5. A3 is a zone thesis, so invalidation is the zone's distal edge, 115.5. The target is the nearest external BSL at 129.5. R = |117.975 - 115.5| = 2.475 and the reach to the target is 11.525, an R-multiple of 4.66 >= 1.5; the levels are coherent, no incident is open and the dedup key is clear, so exactly one signal is written, TTL 18 H4 candles, with the dedup key's band rounded to four significant figures: 120.4:115.5.

Why this series and not an easier one. A first draft published at 73 with F5 carrying 24.5 points of aligned momentum from six up closes out of ten whose ROC was negative -- UP under the engine's count rule, DOWN under 7.1's 'sign sets momentum direction'. That draft published only because of the divergence, so it was rejected. Here the scored window is five up and five down closes with roc -1.39, so the aligned term is zero under either rule. Two known engine findings still touch this record without deciding it: the OB is marked MITIGATED by the displacement candle that confirms it (the 'born MITIGATED' finding), which costs F3 nineteen points of freshness -- corrected, the confidence would be 73 and the verdict the same -- and 8.5's compression_resolved pays +4 for a COMPRESSION event anywhere in the window rather than one resolved by the setup's displacement, which this series is built to avoid. | 2026-09-13 (sweep class taken at the sweep candle, liquidity s5-v11): only pool-id hashes moved -- pool ids embed the liquidity algo version, and the fixed engine with its version literal held at s5-v10 reproduces the previous expected block byte for byte, so no score, gate or verdict changed. | 2026-09-14 (zone interaction walk positioned in time, s6-interaction-v5): zones born on the newest candle used to receive no Section 5.9 interactions at all, so this series' best zone had no history. It now records its first retest as a Respect, and A2's unmet list drops breaker_first_retest_respected. No score, gate, archetype or verdict changed: A2 stays unmet on breaker_formed. Note that the predicate reads the BEST zone's history rather than a breaker's -- tracked as a separate confluence finding. | 2026-09-14 (A2 read off one breaker, s8-confluence-v30): that finding is fixed. A2's first-retest Respect and entry-grade Confirmation now come from the breaker's own history, and this series has no breaker, so breaker_first_retest_respected is unmet again -- the A2 list is back to its pre-v5 form. No score, gate, archetype or verdict changed. | 2026-09-14 (each sweep fact published once, liquidity s5-v12): only pool-id hashes moved -- pool ids embed the liquidity algo version, and the fixed engine with its version literal held at s5-v11 reproduces the previous expected block byte for byte, so no score, gate or verdict changed. | 2026-09-14 (pool map decided by candle order, liquidity s5-v13): pool-id hashes moved with the version, and the target pool is born on its pivot's first confirmation, three candles sooner, so its strength rose 23.54 -> 23.92 (age component +0.375) and F2 with it (80.885 -> 80.979, base confidence 65.133 -> 65.147). Final confidence 70, grade B, the gates and the verdict are unchanged -- with the liquidity version held at s5-v12 in every module those are the only lines that move. | 2026-09-14 (structure s4-v10, facts decided in candle order): three F1 evidence ids moved because structure event keys embed the structure algo version; with the version held at s4-v9 the expectation is reproduced byte for byte. No score, gate, archetype or verdict changed. | 2026-09-15 (each candle decided once, audit M3: liquidity s5-v14, ict s6-v6, ote s6-ote-v6, ob s6-ob-v8, participation v3): only 64-hex ids moved -- pool, zone and evidence ids embed their engine's algo version. With every 64-hex id masked, each removed line equals its added line; no score, gate, archetype or verdict changed. A single pass has no record of decided candles, so M3 changes nothing else here. (Holding the version literals is not a valid check for this change: confluence's CURRENT_ZONE_VERSIONS is built at import time, so held ICT versions filter every zone out.) | 2026-09-16 (sweep maturation decides each candle once, liquidity s5-v15): only pool-id hashes moved -- pool ids embed the liquidity algo version, and the fixed engine with its version literal held at s5-v14 reproduces the previous expected block byte for byte, so no score, gate or verdict changed. | 2026-09-19 (pool lifecycle decides each candle once, liquidity s5-v16): only pool-id hashes moved -- pool ids embed the liquidity algo version, and the fixed engine with its version literal held at s5-v15 reproduces the previous expected block byte for byte, so no score, gate or verdict changed.
